statement0:
The word "believe" is mentioned two or more times in 0.8% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "believe" , 24.4% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a far lower rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "believe" are in the bottom 15th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better).
Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "believe" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (44th percentile among all words) and tend to be cited less (44th percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "believe" (67th percentile).
